• Inter Kashi FC vs Churchill Brothers SC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 35 || 27-Nov-2026 || English ||
The Red Machines are back to winning ways! Watch the big moments as Churchill Brothers SC beat Inter Kashi FC 1-0 in Pune to end a four-game losing run in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
It took until the 53rd minute for the deadlock to break, when Trijoy Dias finished off Sebastian Gutierrez's pass. Inter Kashi pushed for a reply in a feisty game with eight yellow cards, but Churchill saw it out.
